stations.title: Labeled stock and carrier storage
stations.robot_responsibility: robot retrieves and checks actual objects

stations.title: Supported bead/thread assembly bench
stations.robot_responsibility: robot picks, aligns, threads, seats and terminates

stations.title: Enclosed print/cut/drill service
stations.robot_responsibility: robot loads/receives/inspects; device performs qualified job

stations.title: Mechanical test station
stations.robot_responsibility: robot installs fixtures, mounts, pretensions, starts, observes and unloads
stations.device_responsibility: tester supplies controlled movement and acquisition

stations.title: Guarded powered bending station
stations.robot_responsibility: robot mounts/connects/programs; handles only off/cool object

stations.title: Supported reconfiguration station
stations.robot_responsibility: robot makes bounded local contacts, releases and observes

stations.title: CT mounting bench
stations.robot_responsibility: robot mounts, terminates, glues and records state

stations.title: Guarded imaging service
stations.robot_responsibility: robot transfers custody and receives same specimen
stations.device_responsibility: qualified service controls X-ray generation, interlocks and reconstruction

stations.title: Traceable analysis service
stations.robot_responsibility: robot requests/checks outputs and raw links

stations.title: Labeled sample archive
stations.robot_responsibility: robot physically places supported object and closes record

stations.title: Separate damaged-item storage
stations.robot_responsibility: robot isolates only after safe release
stations.device_responsibility: intervention when safe handling is unavailable

analysis_station_semantics: WS_ANALYSIS names data processing, not relocation of the physical sample. Its last physical station remains unchanged.
